pub fn read_to_string(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<String>

Reads the entire contents of a file into a string. The returned value contains the text decoded as UTF-8. The file handle is closed when this operation finishes.

Parameters

  • path: an absolute path or a path relative to the current working directory.
  • The caller must ensure the selected file can be opened for reading.

Errors: returns an error when the file cannot be opened, a read fails, or its contents are not valid UTF-8. Inspect the original error to provide an actionable diagnostic.

Example

let contents = read_to_string("notes.txt")?;
println!("{}", contents);

This operation is intended for small configuration files and source documents. For large files, prefer a buffered reader and process the input incrementally to keep memory usage bounded.
